content:
{
  "markdown": "- Adults aged 18 years or older at the time of informed consent (consistent with NCT06848088, NCT05561491, NCT06190951, NCT06727630, NCT05983237, NCT06081920, NCT05406466).
- Histologically or cytologically confirmed diagnosis of advanced melanoma (unresectable or metastatic) that has progressed after at least one prior systemic therapy for advanced disease.
- Measurable disease per RECIST 1.1 as assessed by the investigator.
- Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 to 1 (consistent with NCT05561491, NCT06190951, NCT05983237, NCT06081920; NCT06727630 allows ECOG 0 only, and NCT05406466 allows ECOG 2, but the more restrictive range is used for this study).
- Life expectancy of at least 12 weeks.
- Adequate bone marrow, hepatic, and renal function as defined by laboratory parameters within normal ranges or per institutional standards.
- Negative serum pregnancy test within 7 days prior to first dose for women of childbearing potential; both men and women of childbearing potential must agree to use highly effective contraception during the study and for at least 6 months after the last dose of study treatment.
- Ability to understand and sign written informed consent and comply with all study procedures.
- Prior treatment with anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapy is allowed, but prior treatment with docetaxel is not permitted.
- No active central nervous system (CNS) metastases, unless previously treated and stable for at least 4 weeks prior to enrollment, with no requirement for corticosteroids.
- No prior allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation or solid organ transplantation.
- No active autoimmune disease requiring systemic immunosuppressive therapy within 2 years prior to enrollment.
- No known hypersensitivity to any component of Drug X or docetaxel.
- No clinically significant cardiovascular disease (e.g., myocardial infarction, unstable angina, congestive heart failure NYHA class III or IV) within 6 months prior to enrollment.
- No active infection requiring systemic therapy within 14 days prior to first dose.
- No history of interstitial lung disease or non-infectious pneumonitis.
- No other malignancy within the past 2 years, except for adequately treated basal cell or squamous cell skin cancer, carcinoma in situ of the cervix, or other localized low-risk malignancies.
- No concurrent participation in another interventional clinical trial.
- Willing and able to comply with scheduled visits, treatment plan, laboratory tests, and other study procedures.
"
